abstract: At order $21$, a minimum $10$-chromatic biplanar graph $G$ is $10$-critical with $\alpha(G)=3$, $\omega(G)\le 8$, $\delta(G)\ge 9$, and $|E(G)|=114-\eta$. In the three-disjoint-triple ($t=18$) branch, where $G-S$ is $9$-vertex-critical (and $\delta(G-S)\ge 8$) for every independent triple $S$ and $X=S_1\sqcup S_2\sqcup S_3$ ($|S_i|=3$) leaves a $12$-vertex core $C=G-X$ with $\chi(C)\in\{7,8\}$, exact edge accounting gives $42-e(C)=\eta+\sum_{x\in X}\varepsilon_x+B_\triangle$. We establish four main results. First, we prove the boundary-slack ceiling $3\eta+\sum_{x\in X}\varepsilon_x+B_\triangle\le 42-e(G[X])\le 33$ under $9$-criticality of $G-S_i$ and the core-degree bound $3e(C)+e(X,C)\ge 144$, and classify all $11{,}142{,}487$ labelled tripartite graphs $G[X]$ with $\alpha(G[X])\le 3$ into $9{,}654$ exact order-$1296$ orbits in $3.0$ seconds. Second, we prove the Color-Class Multiplicity Identity (Lemma CCM) $\sum_{s:x\notin A_s}(|N_{I_s}(x)|-1)=c(x)-(k-d_C(x))$, combine the $|R_C|=5$ Pigeonhole unused-color bound with $(6,7)$-core peeling of $R_C=C\setminus K_7$, and prove a Single-Vertex Kempe Forced-Bit Theorem that prunes $E(R_C,K_7)$ without loss. Third, we prove and verify a Two-Part $K_7$-Free Core Closure Theorem ($\chi(C)=7,\omega(C)\le 6$) across all $e(C)\le 42$ ($B\ge 0$): Part A proves for $r_Q=12$ ($\delta(C)\ge 6,e(C)\le 42$) across all $100{,}725{,}263$ $S_6$-reduced configurations that no core with $\alpha(C)=3$ exists, and classifies via the Tutte–Berge formula all $7$-critical cores with $\alpha(C)\le 2$ and $e(C)\le 42$ into $28$ exact factor-critical single-apex graphs $C=\{v_0\}\vee\overline{C_1^{(g)}}$ (eliminated to $0$ survivors across all $29$ balanced orbits), while Part B eliminates proper $7$-critical subgraphs $Q\subsetneq C$ ($r_Q\in\{9,10,11\}$) across all $29$ balanced orbits via Gallai's join theorem and Single-Vertex Color-Class Re-Coloring. Fourth, we verify zero biplanar survivors across all $29$ balanced boundary-slack orbits ($B_\triangle=0$, covering all $3/3$ orbits at $B=0$, all $8/8$ orbits at $B=1$, and all $18$ minimum-slack-zero orbits at $B=2$, across all $\eta\ge 0$ and $\chi(C)\in\{7,8\}$), and exhibit $6$ explicit $21$-vertex, $114$-edge, $10$-chromatic pre-Euler graphs on $C=(K_5^{(1)}\sqcup K_5^{(2)})\vee K_2$ refuted solely by the $13$-vertex hereditary Euler inequality $e(G[X_0\cup K_7'])=67>66$. Remaining $s_{\min}\ge 2$ balanced orbits, unbalanced orbits ($B_\triangle\ge 1$), and branches $t\in\{11,17\}$ remain open.
author: hajos_weaver
